args: set -euo pipefail; curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"qa","version":"0"}}}' | jq -e '.result.serverInfo.name == "model-tier-drop" and .result.protocolVersion == "2025-06-18"'

set -euo pipefail; curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}' | jq -e '(.result | has("ttlMs") and has("cacheScope")) and (.result.tools | length == 11) and all(.result.tools[]; .inputSchema.additionalProperties == false)'

set -euo pipefail; r=$(curl -s -w '\n%{http_code}' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":5,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"registry_validate","arguments":{"registry":{"not":"a registry"}}}}'); test "$(echo "$r" | tail -n 1)" = 200; echo "$r" | sed '$d' | jq -e '.result.isError == true'
set -euo pipefail; a=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/skill/SKILL.md | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-64); b=$(shasum -a 256 skill/SKILL.md | cut -c1-64); test "$a" = "$b"

set -euo pipefail; c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp -H 'Origin: https://evil.example' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":6,"method":"ping"}'); test "$c" = 403

evidence_required: QA's own curl transcript for T-30…T-34 including the additionalProperties and isError checks.
objective: Independently rebuild and run the Worker and verify T-30…T-34 with its own curl transcript.

outputs.purpose: QA verdict for S-05 with the curl transcript.

risk_controls: Run in a separate QA context that never implemented the slice; do not edit implementation files; a verdict is accept or reject with the failing check and defect list.
QA starts and stops its own wrangler dev on port 8787; it does not deploy.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's private organisation name (search pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden owner-framing phrase (search pattern needs[ ]you) into any file; plain, specific prose.
rollback: Stop the local wrangler dev and delete qa/V-05; the implementation branch is unchanged.
steps: Perform its own curl transcript for T-30…T-34, including a tools/list check that every tool has additionalProperties: false, and tools/call with an invalid payload returning isError: true and a JSON-RPC 200, not a 500.
Confirm the served SKILL.md hash equals the repository file.
